thesis: The podcast argues that the biotech industry is facing a paradox where scientific advancement and AI capabilities are exploding while the business model is collapsing due to increasing regulation, rising costs, and a disconnect between public market pessimism and early-stage technological progress. The speakers diagnose this situation as a structural mismatch where the industry is competing on the wrong metrics, allowing China to win on speed and cost while the FDA adds friction, suggesting that a path forward requires inventing new approaches rather than relying on the old equilibrium.
